name: Time Skip
description: Surge forward in time, causing your cooldowns to recover 1,000% faster for 2 sec.

name: Breath of Eons
description:
Fly to the targeted location, exposing a Temporal Wound on enemies in your path for 10 sec.

Removes roots and grants immunity to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

 Temporal Wound
15% of damage dealt by allies affected by Ebon Might is copied as additional Arcane damage to enemies after 10 sec.

Damage is reduced if Ebon Might affects more than 2 other allies.

name: Oppressing Roar
description: Let out a bone-shaking roar at enemies in a cone in front of you, increasing the duration of crowd controls that affect them by 50% in the next 10 sec.

name: Tip the Scales
description: Compress time to make your next empowered spell cast instantly at its maximum empower level.

name: Zephyr
description: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Landslide
description: Conjure a path of shifting stone towards the target location, rooting enemies for 15 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Bestow Weyrnstone
description: Conjure a pair of Weyrnstones, one for your target ally and one for yourself. Only one ally may bear your Weyrnstone at a time.\n\nA Weyrnstone can be activated by the bearer to transport them to the other Weyrnstone's location, if they are within 100 yds.

name: Cauterizing Flame
description: Cauterize an ally's wounds, removing all Bleed, Poison, Curse, and Disease effects. Heals for 1,330 upon removing any effect.

name: Rescue
description: Swoop to an ally and fly with them to the target location. Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally.

name: Upheaval
description:
Gather earthen power beneath your enemy's feet and send them hurtling upwards, dealing 1,653 Volcanic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Empowering expands the area of effect.

I:   3 yd radius.

II:  6 yd radius.

III: 9 yd radius.

name: Blistering Scales
description:
Protect an ally with 15 explosive dragonscales, increasing their Armor by 20% of your own.

Melee attacks against the target cause 1 scale to explode, dealing 114 Volcanic damage to enemies near them. This damage can only occur every few sec.

Blistering Scales can only be placed on one target at a time. Casts on your enemy's target if they have one.

name: Ebon Might
description:
Increase all damage dealing allies' primary stat by 8.0% of your own and increase your own damage by 20% for 10 sec.

Ebon Might will split its effect when applied to more than 2 other allies.

Eruption, Deep Breath, and your empower spells extend the duration of these effects.

name: Quell
description: Interrupt an enemy's spellcasting and prevent any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 6 sec.

name: Expunge
description: Expunge toxins affecting an ally, removing all Poison effects.

name: Obsidian Scales
description: Reinforce your scales, reducing damage taken by 30% . Lasts 12 sec.

name: Verdant Embrace
description: Fly to an ally and heal them for 5,226, or heal yourself for the same amount.

name: Eruption
description: Cause a violent eruption beneath an enemy's feet, dealing 1,064 Volcanic damage split between them and nearby enemies.

name: Prescience
description: Grant an ally the gift of foresight, increasing their critical strike chance by 3% for 18 sec.\n\nAffects the nearest ally within 25 yds, preferring damage dealers with their cooldowns active, if you do not have an ally targeted.

name: Renewing Blaze
description: Obsidian Scales surrounds you with a Renewing Blaze, causing 100% of the damage it prevented to be healed back over 8 sec.

name: Sleep Walk
description: Disorient an enemy for 20 sec, causing them to sleep walk towards you. Damage has a chance to awaken them.

name: Source of Magic
description: Redirect your excess magic to a friendly healer for 1 hour. When you cast an empowered spell, you restore 0.25% of their maximum mana per empower level. Limit 1.

name: Timelessness
description: Enchant an ally to appear out of sync with the normal flow of time, reducing threat they generate by 30% for 1 hour. Less effective on tank-specialized allies. \n\nMay only be placed on one target at a time.

name: Spatial Paradox
description: Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.\n\nAffects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.

name: Time Spiral
description: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.

name: Fury of the Aspects
description: Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.\n\nAllies receiving this effect will become Exhausted and unable to benefit from Fury of the Aspects or similar effects again for 10 min.

name: Tail Swipe
description: Lash out with your tail, knocking enemies within 8 yds into the air.

name: Emerald Blossom
description: Grow a bulb from the Emerald Dream at an ally's location. After 1.5 sec, heal up to 3 injured allies within 10 yds for 1,227.

name: Blessing of the Bronze
description: Weave the threads of time, reducing the cooldown of a major movement ability for all party and raid members by 15% for 1 hour.

name: Deep Breath
description: Take in a deep breath and fly to the targeted location, spewing molten cinders dealing 3,203 Volcanic damage to enemies in your path.\n\nRemoves all root effects. You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

name: Hover
description: Launch yourself and gain 30% increased movement speed for 6 sec.\n\nAllows Evoker spells to be cast while moving and is castable while casting. Does not affect empowered spells.

name: Sense Power
description: Gauge the magical energy of your allies, showing you when they are using an exceptionally powerful ability.

name: Azure Strike
description: Project intense energy onto 2 enemies, dealing 624 Spellfrost damage to them.

name: Disintegrate
description: Tear into an enemy with a blast of blue magic, inflicting 2,410 Spellfrost damage over 2.7 sec, and slowing their movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

name: Fire Breath
description:
Inhale, stoking your inner flame. Release to exhale, burning enemies in a cone in front of you for 2,300 Fire damage, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Empowering causes more of the damage to be dealt immediately instead of over time.

I:   Deals 619 damage instantly and 1,681 over 20 sec.

II:  Deals 1,138 damage instantly and 1,176 over 14 sec.

III: Deals 1,631 damage instantly and 672 over 8 sec.

name: Living Flame
description: Send a flickering flame towards your target, dealing 891 Fire damage to an enemy or healing an ally for 2,977.

name: Return
description: Brings a dead party member back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Chrono Loop
description: Trap the enemy in a time loop for 5 sec. Afterwards, they are returned to their previous location and health. Cannot reduce an enemy's health below 20%.

name: Time Stop
description: Freeze an ally's timestream for 5 sec. While frozen in time they are invulnerable, cannot act, and auras do not progress.\n\nYou may reactivate Time Stop to end this effect early.

name: Born in Flame
description: Casting Ebon Might grants 2 charges of Burnout, reducing the cast time of Living Flame by 100%.

name: Divide and Conquer
description: Deep Breath forms curtains of fire, preventing line of sight to enemies outside its walls and burning enemies who walk through them for 2,736 Fire damage. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Dreamwalker's Embrace
description: Verdant Embrace tethers you to an ally, increasing movement speed by 40% and slowing and siphoning 475 life from enemies who come in contact with the tether.\n\nThe tether lasts up to 10 sec or until you move more than 30 yards away from your ally.

name: Nullifying Shroud
description: Verdant Embrace wreathes you in arcane energy, preventing the next full loss of control effect against you. Lasts 3 sec.

name: Obsidian Mettle
description: While Obsidian Scales is active you gain immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects.

name: Scouring Flame
description: Fire Breath burns away 2 beneficial Magic effects from all targets.

name: Seismic Slam
description: Landslide causes enemies who are mid-air to be slammed to the ground, stunning them for 4 sec and Landslide's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Unburdened Flight
description: Hover prevents movement speed from being reduced below 100%.

name: Duplicate
description: Breath of Eons summons a version of you from the future to assist you in battle, lasting 20 sec. Your duplicate casts Eruption, Fire Breath, and Upheaval.

name: Accretion
description: Eruption reduces the remaining cooldown of Upheaval by 1.0 sec.

name: Aerial Mastery
description: Hover gains 1 additional charge.

name: Afterimage
description: Empower spells send up to 3 Chrono Flames to your targets.

name: Anachronism
description: Prescience has a 35% chance to grant Essence Burst.

name: Ancient Flame
description: Casting Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace reduces the cast time of your next Living Flame by 40%.

name: Arcane Reach
description: The range of your helpful magics is increased by 5 yards.

name: Aspects' Favor
description: Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by 4.0% for 12 sec.\n\nHover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by 25% for 4 sec.

name: Attuned to the Dream
description: Your healing done and healing received are increased by 2%.

name: Blast Furnace
description: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.

name: Bombardments
description: Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.\n\nYou and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.

name: Bountiful Bloom
description: Emerald Blossom heals 2 additional allies.

name: Chronal Dynamo
description: Living Flame's cast time is reduced by 0.2 sec, and it deals 50% increased damage or healing when it is a non-instant cast.

name: Chrono Flame
description: Living Flame is enhanced with Bronze magic, repeating 25% of the damage or healing you dealt to the target in the last 5 sec as Arcane, up to 950.

name: Chrono Ward
description: When allies deal damage with Temporal Wounds, they gain a shield for 100% of the damage dealt. Absorption cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

name: Chronoboon
description: Tip the Scales' cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Clairvoyant
description: Motes of Possibility may now grant Prescience to allies and have a 10% increased chance to activate.

name: Clobbering Sweep
description: Tail Swipe's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.

name: Command Squadron
description: While flying during Deep Breath you are assisted by a squadron of Dracthyr who assault enemies with Pyre, dealing 955 Fire damage to nearby enemies up to 8 times.

name: Concentrated Power
description: Mass Disintegrate strikes 1 additional target.

name: Defy Fate
description:
Fatal attacks are diverted into a nearby timeline, preventing the damage, and your death, in this one.

The release of temporal energy restores 12,548 health to you, and 4,068 to 4 nearby allies, over 9 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

May only occur once every 6 min.

name: Diverted Power
description: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.

name: Double-time
description: Ebon Might and Prescience gain a chance equal to your critical strike chance to grant 50% additional stats. For Ebon Might, this increase lasts 15.0 sec.

name: Draconic Attunements
description:
Learn to attune yourself to the essence of the Black or Bronze Dragonflights:

Black Attunement: You and your 4 nearest allies have 2% increased maximum health.

Bronze Attunement:You and your 4 nearest allies have 10% increased movement speed.

name: Draconic Legacy
description: Your Stamina is increased by 6%.

name: Dream of Spring
description: Emerald Blossom no longer has a cooldown, deals 35% increased healing, and increases the duration of your active Ebon Might effects by 1 sec, but costs 3 Essence.

name: Echoing Strike
description: Azure Strike deals 15% increased damage and has a 10% chance per target hit to echo, casting again.

name: Enkindled
description: Living Flame deals 3% more damage and healing.

name: Essence Attunement
description: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.

name: Essence Burst
description: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance, and your Azure Strike has a 15% chance, to make your next Eruption cost no Essence.

name: Extended Battle
description: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.

name: Extended Flight
description: Hover lasts 4 sec longer.

name: Exuberance
description: While above 75% health, your movement speed is increased by 10%.

name: Fate Mirror
description: Prescience grants the ally a chance for their spells and abilities to echo their damage or healing, dealing 15% of the amount again.

name: Foci of Life
description: Renewing Blaze restores you more quickly, causing damage you take to be healed back over 4 sec.

name: Font of Magic
description: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.

name: Forger of Mountains
description: Landslide's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, and it can withstand 200% more damage before breaking.

name: Golden Opportunity
description: Prescience lasts 15% longer.

name: Hardened Scales
description: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Heavy Wingbeats
description: Wing Buffet's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.

name: Hoarded Power
description: Essence Burst has a 20% chance to not be consumed.

name: Ignition Rush
description: Essence Burst reduces the cast time of Eruption by 40% and increases its damage by 20%.

name: Imminent Destruction
description: Deep Breath reduces the Essence cost of your next 6 Eruptions by 1.

name: Improved Defy Fate
description: Defy Fate healing increased by 100% and its cooldown is reduced by 1 min.

name: Inferno's Blessing
description: Fire Breath grants the inferno's blessing for 8 sec to you and a nearby ally, giving their damaging attacks and spells a high chance to deal an additional 1,022 Fire damage.

name: Inherent Resistance
description: Magic damage taken reduced by 2%.

name: Innate Magic
description: Essence regenerates 5% faster.

name: Inner Radiance
description: Your Living Flame and Emerald Blossom are 30% more effective on yourself.

name: Instability Matrix
description: Each time you cast an empower spell, unstable time magic reduces its cooldown by up to 6 sec.

name: Instinctive Arcana
description: Your Magic damage done is increased by 2%.

name: Interwoven Threads
description: The cooldowns of your spells are reduced by 10%.

name: Leaping Flames
description: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.

name: Lush Growth
description: Green spells restore 5% more health.

name: Maneuverability
description:
Deep Breath can now be steered in your desired direction.

In addition, Deep Breath burns targets for 3,576 Volcanic damage over 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.

name: Mass Disintegrate
description: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

name: Mass Eruption
description: Empower spells cause your next Eruption to strike up to 3 targets. When striking less than 3 targets, Eruption damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

name: Melt Armor
description: Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.\n\nThe duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.

name: Menacing Presence
description: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.

name: Might of the Black Dragonflight
description: Black spells deal 20% increased damage.

name: Mighty Inferno
description: Inferno's Blessing's damage is increased by 40%, and your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Inferno's Blessing.

name: Molten Blood
description: When cast, Blistering Scales grants the target a shield that absorbs up to 5,700 damage for 30 sec based on their missing health. Lower health targets gain a larger shield.

name: Momentum Shift
description: Consuming Essence Burst grants you 5% Intellect for 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.

name: Motes of Acceleration
description: Warp leaves a trail of Motes of Acceleration. Allies who come in contact with a mote gain 20% increased movement speed for 30 sec.

name: Motes of Possibility
description: Eruption has a 25% chance to form a mote of diverted essence near you. Allies who comes in contact with the mote gain a random buff from your arsenal.

name: Natural Convergence
description: Disintegrate channels 20% faster.

name: Nimble Flyer
description: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.

name: Nozdormu Adept
description: Prescience cooldown reduced by 2 sec and it grants 1% additional critical strike chance.

name: Obsidian Bulwark
description: Obsidian Scales has an additional charge.

name: Onslaught
description: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.

name: Overawe
description: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Overclock
description: Chrono Flames' maximum damage or healing is increased by 40%, up to 1,330 Arcane.

name: Overlord
description: Deep Breath casts an Eruption at the first 3 enemies struck. These Eruptions have a 100% chance to create a Mote of Possibility.

name: Panacea
description: Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace instantly heal you for 950 when cast.

name: Perilous Fate
description: Breath of Eons reduces enemies' movement speed by 70%, and reduces their attack speed by 50%, for 10 sec.

name: Plot the Future
description: Deep Breath grants you Fury of the Aspects for 15 sec after you land, without causing Exhaustion.

name: Potent Mana
description: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.

name: Power Nexus
description: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.

name: Primacy
description: For each damage over time effect from Upheaval, gain 3% haste, up to 9%.

name: Prolong Life
description: Your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Symbiotic Bloom.

name: Protracted Talons
description: Azure Strike damages 1 additional enemy.

name: Pupil of Alexstrasza
description: When cast at an enemy, Living Flame strikes 1 additional enemy for 100% damage.

name: Reactive Hide
description: Each time Blistering Scales explodes it deals 15% more damage for 12 sec, stacking 10 times.

name: Recall
description: You may reactivate Deep Breath within 3 sec after landing to travel back in time to your takeoff location.

name: Refined Essence
description: Essence abilities deal 15% additional damage.

name: Regenerative Chitin
description: Blistering Scales no longer loses charges and deals 20% more damage.

name: Regenerative Magic
description: Your Leech is increased by 2%.

name: Reverberations
description: Upheaval deals 50% additional damage over 8 sec.

name: Ricocheting Pyroclast
description: Eruption deals 30% more damage per enemy struck, up to 150%.

name: Rumbling Earth
description: Upheaval causes an aftershock at its location, dealing 30% of its damage 2 additional times.

name: Scarlet Adaptation
description: Store 20% of your effective healing, up to 857. Your next damaging Living Flame consumes all stored healing to increase its damage dealt.

name: Slipstream
description: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.

name: Stretch Time
description: While flying during Deep Breath, 100% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 10 sec.

name: Strike from Above
description: Glide speed and height increased by 10%.

name: Symbiotic Bloom
description: Emerald Blossom increases targets' healing received by 3% for 10 sec.

name: Tailwind
description: Hover increases your movement speed by 70% for the first 4 sec.

name: Tectonic Locus
description: Upheaval deals 50% increased damage to the primary target, and launches them higher.

name: Temporal Burst
description: Tip the Scales overloads you with temporal energy, increasing your haste, movement speed, and cooldown recovery rate by 30%, decreasing over 30 sec.

name: Temporality
description: Warp reduces damage taken by 20%, starting high and reducing over 3 sec.

name: Terror of the Skies
description: Deep Breath stuns enemies for 3 sec.

name: Time Convergence
description: Non-defensive abilities with a 45 second or longer cooldown grant 5% Intellect for 15 sec.\n\nEssence spells extend the duration by 1 sec.

name: Tomorrow, Today
description: Time Skip channels for 1 sec longer.

name: Twin Guardian
description: Rescue increases movement speed by 100% and allows spells to be cast while moving for 3 sec.

name: Unravel
description: Direct damage from Fire Breath consumes absorb shields from enemies, dealing 4,547 additional Spellfrost damage to them.

name: Unrelenting Siege
description: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.

name: Unyielding Domain
description: Upheaval cannot be interrupted, and has an additional 10% chance to critically strike.

name: Volcanism
description: Eruption's Essence cost is reduced by 1.

name: Walloping Blow
description: Wing Buffet and Tail Swipe knock enemies further and daze them, reducing movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.

name: Warp
description: Hover now causes you to briefly warp out of existence and appear at your destination. Hover's cooldown is also reduced by 5 sec.\n\nHover continues to allow Evoker spells to be cast while moving.

name: Wingleader
description: Mass Disintegrate reduces the remaining cooldown of Deep Breath by 1.0 sec for each target struck.

name: Black Aspect's Favor
description: Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by $<blacktotal>% for $407254d.\n\nHover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by $<bronzetotal>% for $407244d.

name: Black Attunement
description: Attune to Black magic, granting you and your $403208s2 nearest allies $s1% increased maximum health.

name: Bronze Aspect's Favor
description: Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by $<blacktotal>% for $407254d.\n\nHover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by $<bronzetotal>% for $407244d.

name: Bronze Attunement
description: Attune to Bronze magic, granting you and your $403208s2 nearest allies $s1% increased movement speed.

name: Magnified Fate
description: Upheaval magnifies your Fate Mirror effects for $1297728d, increasing the amount of damage echoed to $s1%.

name: Permeating Chill
description: Your damaging Blue spells reduce the target's movement speed by $370898s1% for $370898d.
